sql: SELECT "conversation_monitor_scans".* FROM "conversation_monitor_scans" INNER JOIN "conversation_monitors" ON "conversation_monitors"."id" = "conversation_monitor_scans"."monitor_id" WHERE "conversation_monitor_scans"."enumerated_at" IS NULL AND "conversation_monitor_scans"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "conversation_monitor_scans"."kind" != 'from_now' AND "conversation_monitors"."account_id" = 1 AND "conversation_monitors"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "conversation_monitors"."paused_at" IS NULL AND (conversation_monitor_scans.collection_version = conversation_monitors.collection_version) ORDER BY "conversation_monitor_scans"."id" ASC LIMIT 1000
notes: Scans are the OUTER side; the join is belongs_to :monitor on the monitors PK. The pending scope keeps initial and catch_up scans, which does not imply kind = 'initial'. find_each adds the ORDER BY id / LIMIT 1000.
